name: pipeline-verify-flake
about: #392, the pipeline-regressions verify step (docs/decisions/2026-10-21-pipeline-verify-flakes.md): the runner runs the pipeline scenarios itself, 3 runs on the change, then the ones that failed every run 3 times on the base; a suspect (3/3 on the base, 0/3 on the change) runs 5 more times on each side and counts only if it splits again. Item a's 'who am I' fails 0/3 on the change but passes its confirm round: verify passes and the PR's footer names it as flaky, not counted; 'computer control off' fails on main too and is not the change's. Item b's 'who am I' splits again: verify fails naming the regression, nothing is pushed, and Slack gets the step's name and status, not its log.

data.name: ^verify-1-pipeline-scenarios\.log$
data.label: ^runner verify "pipeline scenarios": log, passed \(0s; flaky, not counted: who am I\)$

a.body: - pipeline scenarios: passed \(0s; flaky, not counted: who am I\); `verify-1-pipeline-scenarios\.log`

run_files.text: pipeline: head, 3 runs, filter '', sandbox loop-1-verify\n[\s\S]*pipeline: base, 3 runs, filter '\^\(computer control off\|who am I\)\$'[\s\S]*pipeline: head, 5 runs, filter '\^\(who am I\)\$'[\s\S]*\[pipeline verify\] regressions: none; flaky, not counted: who am I; failing on the base too: computer control off\n$
